interpretive_rules.statement: Training from scratch on external bAbI QA4 tests whether the architecture can learn this separately authored supervised task under the fixed recipe. It is not transfer of item9 weights or performance outside bAbI's generator.

Both novelty masks remove normalized raw and encoded exact-input overlap with their declared data/fixture exposure sets. They do not imply new semantic structures, unseen vocabulary or all-history human/model blinding.

Both families receive the same ordered training population, paired precomputed sample indices, 4096 optimizer updates and answer-only loss. Their parameter counts are 29552 and 29562. These controls do not equate operation count, memory, wall time, energy or model-specific stochastic state consumption.

On acquired TRAIN, the literal encoder retains the facts/question with no raw or encoded label conflicts, OOVs or overflow; the unlearned raw grammar control answers all rows. These are data/adapter consistency results, not an architecture learnability theorem.

With H4 W8 the maximum Chebyshev distance is7 and the update horizon is16. An immediate hard receptive-field exclusion is not established. The readout's identity-channel bound does not by itself prohibit classification among six observed answer labels. These analytic observations do not diagnose optimization failure.

Both seed58 32-record memorization diagnostics passed; all 895-record full-TRAIN probes remain below95%. Pilot DEV selection values are development evidence; only the full prespecified main panel supports its five-seed contrast.

The primary t interval uses five paired training-realization differences on one fixed official test set, df4. Repeated rows, multiple masks and the 1000 nominal row count are not independent training realizations.

The separate percentile bootstrap resamples connected TEST source components with one common PCG64 index array; it conditions on the fixed checkpoints. Row count changes with unequal component size and subgroup membership. Undefined subset draws do not get silently discarded.
Archive actual Git ancestry and immutable checkpoint/config identity must precede the consumed final-access receipt. Gate success is internal workflow integrity, not externally held blind custody.

Failure of the prospective 95% screen constrains the tested configurations, recipe, training realizations and observed benchmark. It does not prove universal architecture incapacity or separate optimization, representation and data factors causally.
